title: Microproof Accelerator: Seller Lab (Rough)
content:
Purpose / quick pitch:
- One-page seller kit to accelerate micro-proofs (10–30 minute live demos + 1-hour sandbox trials).
- Focus: engineering/architecture-centric prospects who need a fast, low-friction way to validate latency, cost, and reliability claims.
- Outcome we want: get to a signed pilot or a scheduled dedicated POC within 7 calendar days.

Target personas:
- Integration Architect / Platform Engineer: cares about latency SLOs, fallback behavior, VPC/private deploy options.
- ML/Infra Lead: cares about throughput, batching, quantization tradeoffs.
- Product Manager (prototype stage): cares about time-to-demo, end-user UX.

One-slide seller opener (talk track + slide content):
- Headline: "Prove inference at your scale in a morning"
- 3 bullets: validated latency at X qps, predictable cost levers (batching + cache), fallbacks to cheaper variants
- Visual: simple flow: client app -> Redwood routing -> model variant fallback
- Quick stat to anchor credibility: “< 50ms p50 on common dispatch for 512-token prompts (internal)", note: mark as internal benchmark — caveat to share only in technical conversations.

Micro-demo recipe (10–30m):
- Pre-call prep (seller checklist):
  - Ask: expected qps, average prompt length, security constraints (SaaS / on-prem / VPC).
  - Confirm there is a laptop with Docker or terminal access.
  - Create sandbox API key before the call (link to provisioning doc).
- Live steps:
  1) Quick explainer (2m): show the routing policy and failure fallback concept.
  2) Latency show (5m): run the sample script against hosted endpoint with a 256-token prompt. Share p50/p95 in real time.
  3) Cost demo (3m): flip quantization/ batching flags and show estimated cost delta from the console.
  4) Failure handling (3m): simulate a model OOM and show automatic fallback to a smaller variant.
  5) Next-step ask (1m): propose a 1-week sandbox with real traffic or a 30-60 day reserved capacity pilot.

Micro-sandbox (1-hour) quick plan (post-demo):
- Deliverable: sandbox API key + preconfigured model config (batching, cache TTL, quantization profile) + sample load script.
- Success metric (seller asks the prospect to agree): p95 < target latency; cost per 1k tokens within agreed threshold; no severity rebounds during spike tests.
- Exit gates: either schedule technical handoff to solutions engineering for a pilot or close as "needs internal procurement".

Objection playbook (concise scripts):
- "We can't share data with hosted providers": "We offer Private (VPC/on-prem) and dedicated pools; we can run the same micro-demo in your VPC or with data anonymized — which would you prefer for the sandbox?"
- "Latency will be worse in real traffic": "Let's run a small spike test in the sandbox (script included) that mirrors your tail traffic to validate p95 under load."
- "Cost sounds high": "We can toggle batching/quant mode and show a side-by-side cost delta in the console; plus, we'll propose a reserved-capacity commit to get predictable unit economics."

Technical pre-reqs (minimal):
- Outbound HTTPS allowed, ability to run a short Python script or curl, optional: access to a GCP/Azure account for private deployment trial.
- If prospect needs VPC: solutions engineer SLA ~3 business days to prep a VPC sandbox (note: confirm calendar).

Seller-facing micro-slide deck outline (4 slides):
1) Why microproofs? (value prop + time-to-evidence)
2) What we'll measure (latency, throughput, cost) + simple metrics table
3) Live demo flow and expectations (Pre-call checklist + roles)
4) Clear next steps and handoff options (sandbox -> pilot -> reserve)

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Q: can we add a one-click sandbox creation link in Console for sellers? (Talk to Platform PM - Priya)
- TODO: build a short script that simulates "tail traffic" patterns used by fintech customers. Owner: Noah. Deadline: 2025-10-10.
- TODO: get legal-approved language for "internal benchmarks" to use in technical decks. Owner: Liam.

Assets to create for v1:
- 2-minute explainer animated GIF of fallback behavior (needs design time)
- 10-line Python demo script with flags for batch/quant/fallback (place in GH repo, link above)
- One-pager email template for post-demo follow-up that includes the sandbox key and instructions

Notes for handoff to SE / Solutions Engineering:
- Include expected qps, token distribution histogram (if available), compliance requirements (SOC2, HIPAA, etc.), and the preferred next step (sandbox vs pilot).
- SE should prepare a lightweight runbook: how to instrument KV cache and trace token-level latency.

Risk checklist (for seller to triage during qualification):
- Data residency constraints (yes/no).
- Procurement lead time > 30 days? (flag as "procurement risk").
- Integration team headcount < 2? (might need Redwood concierge assist).

Script snippets (copy-and-paste for sellers):
- Pre-demo ask template: "For the micro-demo we'll need a quick confirmation of: expected QPS, sample prompt length (tokens), and any compliance constraints. Can you DM those now?"
- Post-demo next step: "Thanks — here's your sandbox key (expires in 7 days). I'll set up a 1-hour spike test; propose Tue/Thu this week. Who should I loop in for procurement?"

Slack / comms pointers:
- Use #se-microproofs for quick coordination; tag @Noah for load script help and @Priya for console setups.
- If a prospect needs an on-prem micro-demo, escalate with subject line: "Microproof: On-prem need — account X" and include timeline.

Metrics to track (for program health):
- # micro-demos run / week
- % micro-demos that convert to pilot within 14 days
- average time from first demo to pilot kickoff

Rough timeline for rollout (internal):
- Week 0: finalize seller deck and demo script (this doc)
- Week 1: enable 10 sellers with sandbox provisioning and run beta demos
- Week 3: iterate on scripts / objections from beta and produce GIF asset

Final random notes / scratchpad:
- Quick idea: badge for "microproof-complete" in CRM when sandbox metrics hit target — makes follow-up easier for AE.
- Keep language lightweight — sellers prefer "show me, don't tell me" for this audience.

Links referenced (placeholders):
- Sandbox provisioning: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/sandbox-provisioning
- Demo scripts GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/microproof-scripts
